page_title: REN 1-0 HAV | Rennes v Le Havre 25/10/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' That's it for today, Florent Batta has blown his whistle and the game is over.

90+5' Christopher Operi (Le Havre) is given a second yellow card for his behaviour. He said too much to the referee and Florent Batta sent him off. One can only wonder what was going on his head. He has weakened his team.
90+5' Christopher Operi (Le Havre) uses bad language while talking to the referee and receives a yellow card for dissent.

90+5' Amine Gouiri (Rennes) steadies himself on the edge of the box and releases a precise effort on goal that just narrowly sails past the right post. The ball goes out of play and Le Havre will have a goal kick.
90+2' Loic Nego (Le Havre) is the one to unleash a good effort towards the bottom left corner. His shot, however, is saved by the goalkeeper. What a save!
90' The fourth official shows 4 min. of added time.
89' Florent Batta shows the yellow card to Etienne Youte Kinkoue (Le Havre) for a heavy challenge.

82' Baptiste Santamaria (Rennes) finds himself in space on the edge of the box and smashes a glorious looking effort towards the bottom left corner, but Arthur Desmas thwarts him with a great two-handed save.
82' Rennes take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.

82' The Rennes players are exchanging some short passes and control the game at the moment, but one of the defending players steps in and intercepts the ball. The ball goes out of play and Rennes have been awarded a corner kick.
79' A substitution has been made. Albert Gronbaek goes off and Baptiste Santamaria (Rennes) comes on.
78' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Hans Hateboer (Rennes) will replace Alidu Seidu.
76' Didier Digard has decided to make a change. Issa Soumare (Le Havre) replaces Oussama Targhalline.
74' Mikayil Faye (Rennes) just cannot continue due to injury and has to be substituted. Leo Ostigard replaces him.
73' Emmanuel Sabbi (Le Havre) commits a rough challenge and Florent Batta blows his whistle for an infringement.
73' The corner by Ludovic Blas (Rennes) lacks accuracy as it's hit with too much power.

72' Decent spell from Rennes here and they keep the pressure on until one of the defending players steps in. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Rennes will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
70' Here is a change. Timothee Pembele is going off and Didier Digard gives the last tactical orders to Emmanuel Sabbi (Le Havre).
70' Substitution. Loic Nego (Le Havre) on for Ilyes Housni.
70' Julien Stephan decides to make a substitution. Carlos Andres Gomez will be replaced by Lorenz Assignon (Rennes).
70' Jota will be replaced by Amine Gouiri (Rennes).
67' Yassine Kechta (Le Havre) does his best to latch onto a cross into the box, but he can't get to the ball. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Rennes.
66' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Albert Gronbaek (Rennes) was quite harsh and Florent Batta didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
65' The actual number of corner kicks in this match – 12:0.
63' Arnaud Kalimuendo (Rennes) attempted to create a dangerous situation in front of goal by sending a cross into the box, but the defence easily dealt with the threat.
61' Arnaud Kalimuendo (Rennes) shows too much aggression while trying to break free from his opponent and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
60' Florent Batta has a clear sight and sees a foul from Christopher Wooh (Rennes).
56' Timothee Pembele (Le Havre) connects with a cross and has an effort on goal from the edge of the box, but it ends somewhere in row Z. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Rennes.
54' 1 - 0 What a beauty from just outside the box! Carlos Andres Gomez (Rennes) lashed the ball with incredible pace and power inside the left post.
52' The resulting corner from Albert Gronbaek (Rennes) only finds one of the defenders, who heads it out of danger.
52' Jota (Rennes) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared. Rennes have been awarded a corner kick.
52' Andre Ayew (Le Havre) is offside and the linesman raises his flag.
52' Andre Ayew (Le Havre) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
48' The corner kick from Albert Gronbaek (Rennes) is headed out of the penalty area by one of the defenders.
48' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Adrien Truffert (Rennes). The linesman makes the right call and Rennes will have a corner.
46' The second half has just started.
45+1' The match has reached half-time.
41' Albert Gronbaek (Rennes) takes the corner, but one of the defenders reacts well and rises highest to head the ball away.
41' Rennes are enjoying a spell of pressure at the moment, but one of the defenders gets it clear. The ball is out of play. Rennes will have a chance to score from a corner.
35' It must be a yellow card. It is. Yoann Salmier (Le Havre) receives the caution after an awful tackle.
32' Alidu Seidu (Rennes) is awarded a yellow card for his tackle. He doesn't seem to agree with the decision, but Florent Batta ignores the protests.
31' The corner from Ludovic Blas (Rennes) is hurriedly cleared.
31' Ludovic Blas (Rennes) blasts the ball from just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by the defender. Rennes have a corner.
30' Albert Gronbaek (Rennes) lifts the ball into the box from the corner, but one of the defending players gets there first to head it clear.

30' Christopher Wooh (Rennes) fires a shot at goal from a very promising position outside the penalty area, but it is blocked by a self-sacrificing defender. Rennes force a corner. They send men into the box.
30' Rennes take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
29' The ball is cleared after Ludovic Blas (Rennes) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. The referee signals a corner kick to Rennes.
28' Abdoulaye Toure (Le Havre) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Florent Batta saw the whole situation.
27' Adrien Truffert (Rennes) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Florent Batta signals.
24' The resulting corner from Albert Gronbaek (Rennes) is cleared by the opposition's defence.
24' Adrien Truffert (Rennes) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it. Now Rennes have a corner.
23' Albert Gronbaek (Rennes) steps up to take the corner, but the ball just sails in among the defenders.

22' Ludovic Blas (Rennes) takes the corner kick and sends a lovely ball into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and knocks the ball to safety. The ball is out of play and Rennes manage to earn a corner.

22' Rennes are showing great team-chemistry. They are passing the ball around seamlessly but finally one of the defending players makes an interception. The ball goes out of play. Rennes are awarded a corner kick.
19' The corner is flicked onto Christopher Wooh (Rennes), but his close-range header flies a whisker wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Le Havre will have a goal kick.
19' Ludovic Blas (Rennes) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will swing the ball into the penalty box.
18' Albert Gronbaek (Rennes) takes the corner, but the goalkeeper jumps and gathers the ball. Rennes force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.

18' Ludovic Blas (Rennes) steadies himself and bends in a shot from the edge of the box towards the bottom left corner, but Arthur Desmas has it covered and makes a comfortable save. The ball is out of play. Rennes win a corner kick.
17' A cross by Oussama Targhalline (Le Havre) from the side of the pitch flies into the box, but fails to find its intended target as the aim was poor.
15' A promising cross into the box is nearly received by the lurking Ilyes Housni (Le Havre), but one of the defending players cuts it out to avert the threat.
14' Carlos Andres Gomez (Rennes) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent.
11' Florent Batta blows for a foul after Mikayil Faye (Rennes) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
10' Albert Gronbaek (Rennes) fails to produce a decent cross from the corner kick. The ball goes well out of play.
10' Jota (Rennes) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. The ball goes out for a corner. Rennes can continue in their attacking effort.
6' Carlos Andres Gomez (Rennes) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
3' Carlos Andres Gomez (Rennes) manages to dispossess his opponent of the ball, but he commits a foul in the process and the referee blows his whistle.
2' Etienne Youte Kinkoue (Le Havre) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
2' Rennes are showing great team chemistry. They are passing the ball around seamlessly.
1' The first half has started.
Rennes will kick-off.
